attBesluta.text: Great quality and folds away neatly to fit in the car.

The ramp arrived quickly, and I'm very happy with the quality. I bought it for my French Bulldog because, for her health and safety, I don't want her jumping in and out of my SUV, particularly as she gets older. I was amazed at how quickly she worked it out! It only took two attempts and a treat, and she was happily using it like a pro! The ramp is quite heavy, but it's very sturdy and built to accommodate a dog about ten times her size! LOL. Overall, I'm extremely happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone wanting to protect their dog's joints and make getting in and out of the car safer and easier.

It is always a surprise to see the quality of items shipped by this company. This dog ramp is no exception. Purchased as an outdoor stair ramp for an aging animal, it has stood up to the water and sun magnificently.
Conforme à mes attentes: suffisamment solide et pratique. Bon rapport qualité-prix.

Our Staffy Boxer mix is about to turn 13 and has recently been diagnosed with osteoarthritis. She LOVES car rides but getting in and out had become more and more difficult. This ramp has been a game changer. Once we went up/down a few times with treats and holding her harness, she is now a pro and has little trouble getting in or out of the car. Easy to fold/unfold and it stores perfectly in the car. Definitely recommend. She is 90 pounds. I stood on this ramp and it felt very secure and I'm twice her weight.

We hebben hem gekocht voor de reis naar Spanje met onze twee oude honden. De honden wende snel aan de loopplank en ze kunnen nu eenvoudig in- en uitlopen. De loopplank kan eenvoudig aan de zijkant rechtovereind opgeborgen worden met een elastiek. Daardoor neemt het maar 10 cm ruimte in. We hebben een Husky en een Border Collie. Er kan zelfs nog een koelbox erbij staan. We rijden in een Ford Focus station. En de service van Vevor is fantastisch. Product is snel geleverd en de klantenservice erg behulpzaam. Kortom top!
